name: fix-failing-test
description: A unit test fails because median() returns the upper middle value instead of the mean of the two middle values for an even-length input.
proves: the canonical agent loop: run a test, read the failure, locate the cause, edit the source, re-run
prompt:
The test suite in this project fails. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -q` to see it, find the cause in the source, and fix it so every test passes.

Rules: fix the implementation, not the tests. Do not edit `test_ledger.py`, do not skip, xfail or delete any test, and do not change what any test asserts.

pre_checks.label: the fixture's test suite fails before the agent runs

checks.label: no test was skipped or marked expected-failure
nothing outside the project was touched
